rule: Each task's per-turn output allowance in MCP mode covers almost all observed turns: the most one model call (turn) needed over every recorded MCP-mode session (a turn cut off at the cap counts as at least its cap), times 6/5, rounded up to a multiple of 2,000, never below the print's own allowance. The same for every model. Thinking budgets and the $1 session cap are unchanged. Frozen for the counted windows; a session that never answers counts as zero. Changes only by a dated revision (D120).
